title: DB-backed profile edit
steps: On a disposable DB copy, open a DB-backed person in Workbench, change a non-identity leaf field, save, reload and compare the stored record.
expected: Edited field persists; unknown nested metadata and untouched defaults remain unchanged.

title: Schema validation and concurrent conflict
steps: Attempt an invalid schema value, then simulate an external DB writer changing the same record before Save.
expected: Invalid value is rejected and focused; conflicting save is blocked without overwriting the external change.

title: Unsaved profile and standalone editor
steps: Edit a Workbench profile and cancel navigation; separately launch standalone DB Editor and load, validate and save a disposable record.
expected: Cancelled navigation retains the draft; standalone editor functions independently with full schema controls.

title: KB-only profile eligibility
steps: Select a recognition-only person without a DB record and inspect profile edit controls.
expected: No nonexistent DB record is edited or implicitly created; KB-only management remains explicit.

title: Exact-person round trip
steps: Select person A in Workbench, open Advanced DB Editor, return via Open in Workbench, and repeat with Gallery or Assessment selected internally.
expected: Both editors and shared context show A, internal Workbench tab is preserved, and tab changes do not restart analyses.

title: Dirty and disappearing person
steps: Cancel a navigation attempt with unsaved DB/profile edits; on a disposable DB copy remove the selected record before handoff.
expected: No silent discard and no substitution with a different person; missing record produces a warning.

title: Roster search, sort and source filter
steps: Search by name, alias and ID; sort several columns; switch All, DB-backed and KB-only filters and inspect the selected person.
expected: Visible rows and counts match filters; sorting preserves boolean values and exact selected identity.

title: Portrait, refresh and dirty selection
steps: Scroll to uncached portraits, refresh repeatedly, revisit cached portraits and reject a selection change while editing.
expected: Portraits arrive without GUI freeze or stale display; lifecycle stays bounded and unsaved draft is retained.

title: Primary and Advanced Tools menus
steps: Inspect principal five Workbench actions, open DB Editor and legacy browser, open/cancel five legacy dialogs, test shortcuts, and locate global re-encoding without running it.
expected: Every intended entry point is available, no unintended worker starts, shortcuts route correctly, global encoding remains distinct.

title: Add Person management parity
steps: Using disposable DB/KB fixtures, exercise DB-backed and KB-only Add eligibility, cancellation during confirmation, changed context/inputs, forced worker failure and Activity outcome.
expected: Only confirmed current inputs dispatch; cancellation/failure leaves no partial person; appropriate KB-only restriction and Activity result are visible.

title: Rename Person management parity
steps: On disposable copies, rename DB-backed and KB-only persons; test cancel, canonical whitespace, changed source/state during confirmation, injected failure and Activity.
expected: Canonical identity remains synchronized; stale rename is blocked; failure leaves original identity and files intact.

title: Remove Person management parity
steps: On disposable copies only, test DB-backed and KB-only Remove review, default media preservation, cancel, changed confirmed folder, injected failure and Activity.
expected: Only the exact confirmed targets can be removed; cancelled/failed operations preserve data and report outcome.

title: Image Management parity
steps: On disposable KB profiles, stage additions/removals (including empty profile), cancel, retarget or replace an image during confirmation, force failure and inspect Activity.
expected: Exact captured image set is honored; obsolete/stopped requests do not dispatch; failures leave original KB images unchanged.

title: Controlled Re-encoding parity
steps: On disposable KB/bank copies, encode DB-backed and KB-only persons; cancel; change confirmed image snapshot while queued; force failed bank write; inspect Activity.
expected: Stale inputs are rejected under lock, backup rollback preserves embeddings and failures surface as errors without modifying other persons.
